selected_method: TriChart shared_consistency with Q-PLE, T-PLE, and universal empirical-midrank views
selection_evidence: beats typed Q-PLE and typed T-PLE in all 11 single-seed validation cells across Weather, Cooking Time, Delivery ETA, and Maps Routing
confirmation_gate: positive mean validation gain versus both Q-PLE and T-PLE on every dataset, at least 25/33 wins versus each baseline, and positive overall mean gain versus each
test_policy: validation is the confirmation endpoint; test metrics remain descriptive because all test partitions appeared earlier in Day 4
efficiency_claim_boundary: shares one backbone but evaluates it once per chart; fewer backbone parameters than three independent models, not lower FLOPs than a single-view model
